drums.description: Hard rock drum solo, The performance features a high-velocity double-kick drum pattern maintaining consistent sixteenth notes, The snare drum is tuned high with a sharp, cracking timbre and is played with heavy rimshots, Frequent syncopated accents are distributed across multiple rack toms and floor toms during rapid fills, The ride cymbal is played on the bell with a distinct, piercing ping, while various crash cymbals are struck with high force for punctuating accents, The hi-hat is kept slightly open to produce a sustained sizzle, The recording environment has a large room reverb with significant compression on the overhead microphones, Tempo is 145 BPM in 4/4 time Publish

bass.description: Funk rock, A clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, percussive riff using 16th-note scratches and palm muting, A slap bass guitar follows the guitar rhythm with aggressive thumb pops and finger plucks, The drum kit maintains a steady groove with a tight, dry snare and a consistent kick pattern, The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E minor, The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interlocking rhythmic relationship between the bass and guitar, The guitar tone is bright with a slight mid-range boost, while the bass has a high-frequency clank characteristic of new roundwound strings Publish
